verdict.rationale: Unleash documents segments as reusable collections of strategy constraints that can be defined once and reused across any number of flags. Activation strategies enable features for certain users, targeting rules use attributes such as user IDs, emails and IPs, and strategy variants expose different versions to users. A dated community comment calls Unleash's rule system more limited than LaunchDarkly's, but it is vague and not a concrete counter-example, so it only lowers confidence. Missing for 10: detailed evidence of constraint operators and attribute-matching semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration of targeting behavior.
